Activated charcoal may also help improve kidney function and lower cholesterol levels. Activated Charcoal Supplements Country Life Vitamins Activated Charcoal capsules offer a convenient way to help relieve occasional digestive discomfort. 757.description_text: Zinc is an essential micronutrient found in cells throughout your body and is crucial to many aspects of your health. Some of the benefits it provides include: Helping strengthen your immune system Supporting your body’s protein production Assisting your body in making DNA Helping wound heal Chelated Zinc Supplements Chelated zinc is a type of zinc supplement that contains zinc that’s been attached to a chelating agent. What are chelating agents? These are chemical compounds that bond with metal ions (like zinc) to create a stable, water-soluble product that the body can easily absorb. Chelated minerals (like chelated zinc) are minerals that have been chemically combined with amino acids. The body absorbs amino acids effectively, so combining the amino acids with the minerals means the body can absorb them more easily and efficiently. This gives chelated minerals higher bioavailability than non-chelated minerals. Since it’s difficult for your body to efficiently absorb zinc on its own, zinc is often attached to a chelating agent in supplements. If you’re looking for zinc tablets to enhance zinc absorption, shop online for our chelated zinc vitamins, zinc 50 mg supplements, and more.

766.description_text: Magnesium and potassium are both beneficial for our overall health. But did you know they make a power couple? These two supplements provide many benefits on their own but also work together in a lot of ways, especially when it comes to maintaining already healthy blood pressure. Benefits of Magnesium Magnesium helps support heart, bone, and muscle health. Heart health—Magnesium stands out in particular for its ability to promote arterial health, and support already healthy blood pressure levels. Its ability to transport potassium and calcium also positively impacts healthy heart rhythms. Bone health—Because so much of the body's magnesium is stored in the bones, it helps maintain healthy bone mineral density in both men and women. Muscle health—Magnesium plays a role in the active transport of calcium and potassium ions across cells, which is an important process for muscle contraction. Benefits of Potassium Some of potassium’s roles complement what magnesium and other minerals do for the body. Supports healthy blood flow—Potassium helps with blood vessel expansion, which supports healthy blood flow. It also supports a steady heartbeat. Helps remove sodium from the body—Potassium acts as a counterbalance to sodium and helps filter it out of the body through urine, helping to support healthy blood pressure levels. Potassium and Magnesium Aspartate Potassium and magnesium are essential for healthy nerve impulse function, muscle contraction, cardiovascular function, acid/alkaline balance, and carbohydrate and nutrient metabolism. Magnesium also plays an important role in facilitating potassium utilization. Potassium and magnesium aspartate are a dream duo for heart health. Studies have even found that together, the magnesium-potassium combination provides powerful support for cardiovascular health, especially when it comes to healthy blood pressure support. In addition to our Target-Mins® Magnesium Potassium Aspartate supplement, check out our Calcium Magnesium Potassium Supplement.

855.description_text: Dihydromyricetin, commonly called DHM, is a naturally occurring flavonoid found in the Japanese raisin tree and other plants traditionally used in East Asian wellness practices.DHM has been studied for its potential role in supporting the body’s natural alcohol-metabolism pathways. Alcohol is processed in two main steps: alcohol dehydrogenase, or ADH, converts ethanol into acetaldehyde, and aldehyde dehydrogenase, or ALDH, then converts acetaldehyde into acetate. Preclinical research suggests that DHM may support the activity and expression of enzymes involved in this process.DHM has also been studied for its interaction with GABA-A receptors, which are involved in the nervous system’s response to alcohol. Because much of this research is preclinical, additional human studies are needed to determine how these effects translate to people.Beyond alcohol metabolism, preclinical research suggests that DHM may support liver health by helping protect against oxidative stress and unwanted fat accumulation associated with alcohol exposure.

Glutathione is a very potent antioxidant that is naturally produced by the body (and the only one that is intracellular). It has been shown to support neuron health, liver function, and immune system health. After age 45, the body begins to produce less and less Glutathione and many individuals begin to support their glutathione levels through supplementation. Unfortunately, most Glutathione supplements have nearly no bioavailability, as the molecule breaks down rapidly after oral ingestion. S-Acetyl L-Glutathione is an altered form with an attached acetyl function group. 885.description_text: Zinc is an essential mineral which is used in countless bodily processes. While large amount of Zinc is not required to prevent deficiency, the body does not store Zinc and so deficiencies can quickly form in people who aren’t consistently getting a high enough intake from diet. Zinc alone has very poor bioavailability so it is usually sold in a chelate form with it bonded to another molecule to improve uptake. 897.description_text: Inositol (specifically myo-inositol) is a stereoisomer known as a pseudovitamin for its close relation to B-complex vitamins without having the same physiologic action as actual B vitamins. Though it is often referred to as Vitamin B8, inositol is actually a type of sugar which has several important bodily functions such as making up cell membranes, influencing the action of insulin, and helping to regulate neurotransmitter levels. 985.description_text: Keep your immune system working at its best with four of our most potent immune support supplements: Artemisinin, Vitamin D3 + K2, Quercetin, and Zinc Picolinate. 986.description_text: Our Men's Health Stack contains: Tongkat Ali (Eurycoma longifolia) - (500mg per capsule, Eurycoma longifolia) — Standardized to 2% eurycomanone, the primary bioactive compound linked to testosterone support and adaptogenic effects. Eurycomanone is the benchmark by which Tongkat Ali quality is measured; unstandarized extracts vary widely in potency. Promotes healthy testosterone levels, supports lean muscle development, and helps the body adapt to physical and mental stress. Every batch is third-party tested for identity, potency, and heavy metals. Fadogia Agrestis - (300mg per capsule) — Traditionally used in West African herbal practice to support stamina and physical performance. Research suggests Fadogia may support the body's own testosterone production via luteinizing hormone (LH) stimulation — without synthetic hormones or additives. Note: Fadogia studies are primarily in animal models; human clinical data is limited. Consult a healthcare provider before long-term use. Turkesterone - (500mg per capsule) — Ajuga turkestanica extract, standardized to 10% turkesterone) — A phytoecdysteroid studied for its ability to support lean muscle growth, protein synthesis, endurance, and post-workout recovery. Best absorbed when taken with a meal or dietary fats. Why These Three Work Together Tongkat Ali and Fadogia Agrestis address different parts of the testosterone support pathway. Tongkat Ali (via eurycomanone) appears to inhibit sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG), which can increase free testosterone availability. Fadogia Agrestis may stimulate luteinizing hormone (LH), which signals the body to produce more testosterone. Together, they support both free testosterone availability and natural testosterone production. Turkesterone operates through a separate mechanism entirely — it appears to support protein synthesis and nitrogen retention at the cellular level, supporting lean muscle growth and recovery without acting on the androgen pathway. This makes it complementary rather than redundant: testosterone support (Tongkat Ali + Fadogia) pairs with muscle-building support (Turkesterone) for a more comprehensive outcome.
